description_expanded: OverviewSleeps 4, STEPS to GULF, POOL, Bikes, Beach Gear, Newly Renovated! 'BeeBy The Ocean'The Space BeeBy the Ocean – Cozy Gulf-View Retreat Just Steps from the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 50 Steps to the Beach – Easy access to sugar-white sands & emerald waters Gated Community with Private Pool – Relax in a secure & exclusive setting 2nd-Floor Location – Enjoy stunning Gulf views & coastal breezes (No elevator) 1 King Master Suite + Custom Twin Bunk – Comfortably sleeps up to 4 guests Private Balcony with Alfresco Dining – Perfect for morning coffee or evening wine Fully Equipped Kitchen – Modern appliances & everything you need for home-cooked meals 2 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic paths & nearby Rosemary Beach Community Grill Near Pool – Ideal for vacation cookouts Parking for 1 Vehicle – Hassle-free & convenient Cable TV + Smart TV & High-Speed Wi-Fi – Stay connected & entertained Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free stayWelcome to BeeBy the OceanDiscover comfort and style at BeeBy the Ocean, a beautifully decorated one-bedroom condo on the 2nd floor in Inlet Beach, FL. Perfect for up to 4 guests, this charming retreat is just 50 steps from our pristine white sand beaches and offers stunning gulf views. Positioned across from Cobia Reef, an exciting artificial reef, you'll have easy access to paddleboarding, kayaking, or guided tours to explore the vibrant marine life. After your adventures, return to BeeBy the Ocean to enjoy a meal in the fully-equipped kitchen and unwind on the balcony with the soothing sounds of the gulf. Enjoy access to the community pool and nearby grill for added relaxation.Upon entering, you'll find yourself in a welcoming open-concept living area that combines the living room, dining space, and kitchen. This area is ideal for relaxing and feeling right at home. With cable TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a fully-equipped kitchen, you'll have all the amenities you need. Start your day with a fresh cup of coffee and step out onto the balcony through the sliding glass doors, where you can enjoy views of the community pool and lush landscaping, with the gulf in the distance.In the hallway adjacent to the living area, discover custom-built twin over twin bunk beds, perfect for kids or additional guests. A convenient closet with a washer and dryer is also located here. The King Master Suite features a comfortable king-sized bed, a flat-screen TV, a dresser, and a closet. At the end of the hallway, the freshly-renovated bathroom includes a spacious walk-in shower.You’ll have full access to the condo and all community amenities, ensuring a complete and enjoyable stay.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**A starter kit with essential amenities will be provided to make your arrival smooth and easy.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4)Master Bedroom – King sized bedCommon Space – Twin bunk bedsWe look forward to hosting you at BeeBy the Ocean!Show less
